Definition: to cleave or burst through, i.e. (causatively) to emit, whether literal or figurative (gape)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to separate, set free, remove, open, escape, burst through; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to remove (oneself), escape; 1a2) to set free, let out
